description: Iconem's mission is to contribute to heritage conservation. By scanning threatened sites, we hope to facilitate their exploration and study, for today and tomorrow.

team.title: Our team
team.description: Based in Paris, Iconem currently brings together a multidisciplinary team of architects, computer scientists, engineers, 3D graphic designers and archeologists whose strength lies in working together to solve the complex issue of safeguarding cultural and archeological heritage.
